\ndef transform(grid):

    border, inner = [c for c, _ in counts.most_common(2)]

    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[[0]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):

        for c,x in enumerate(row):

'''

code='''from collections import Counter
\ndef transform(grid):
    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*m for _ in grid]
    boxes=[]
    for color in set(x for row in grid for x in row if x):

        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        size=max(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1)
        boxes.append((size,color))
    for size,color in sorted(boxes,reverse=True):
        r0=(n-size)//2; c0=(m-size)//2
        for r in range(r0,r0+size):
            for c in range(c0,c0+size): out[r][c]=color
    return out
